body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY REVIEW of D2 0bf780a — ACCEPT.

Exact SHA 0bf780a3d1834606b9491f2e19804d55b053c29c. Parent is current main b1f5153. Only that commit is unlanded. Five reserved paths. I did not run the gate; author evidence stands.

WHAT IS CLOSED:
  - Bare `private` constructor on a `final class`, not `private[interview]`. No `copy`.
  - Not a case class, so no `fromProduct` / `Mirror.ProductOf` / `Product`.
  - Probe is in `storymodel4s.interviewprobe`, outside the defining package.
  - Construction path exists: `of` (checked) and `unsafe` (throw). Sub-shape (a) is built, not only the door closed.
  - Rejection tests now fail at `of`, not `validated` on a forged instance.
  - Structural `equals`/`hashCode` and redacted `toString` (no cue text) are tested.
  - Construction sites migrated: BirthdayInterview and InductionSuite use `unsafe`; InterviewSuite uses `of`. Codec does not name InterviewSource.

CONTROLS:
  - Positive: `Mirror.ProductOf[Cue]` (live public case class, same module) and `InterviewModel.fromProduct` (remaining `private[interview]` case class). Same-shape, not a tuple.
  - Negatives: apply, copy, Product, fromProduct, Mirror.ProductOf.

I did not re-run the class-to-case-class mutation. The author reported it killed the two boundary tests after a clean compile; I am accepting that report, not repeating it.

NARROWS, not blocks:
  - `unsafe` remains a public throw door. Same fixture pattern as `TranscriptAtlas.unsafe`. Fine if it stays test/fixture-side.
  - `validated` still returns `InterviewSource`. That is correct now: the constructor is private, so the signature is no longer the advisory-validator defect.

Chief: merged-tree gate is yours. I hold nothing.
